title: A worker the executor refused to start earns no escalation rung
description: From #50: only claim_width refusals are now kept from escalating the tier. An attempt whose START was refused by the executor also ran nothing, yet it marks the tick rejected and earns a rung on resume. Record that the attempt never started (durably, on the attempt record) and exclude such attempts from the ladder's failure count.
acceptance_criteria: An attempt whose start the executor refused is recorded as never-started and does not count as a failure for escalation; a test drives a start refusal then a resume and asserts the tier is unchanged
